name: Light Dum Aloo
ingredients: ½ cup plain non-fat Greek yogurt
Ginger, jeera, turmeric and ½ tsp oil
steps: Heat oil with ginger and jeera.
Add potatoes and yogurt on low heat; add tofu and simmer.
note: Potato remains the main carbohydrate source; keep the portion measured.

inspirationReferences.title: Dum Aloo Banarasi
inspirationReferences.note: Banarasi potato curry seasoning and simmering method; our lighter measured-oil approach is an adaptation.
